Definition: of uncertain derivation; to menace; by implication, to forbid:--threaten.
BiblicalUsage: To threaten — the council threatening the apostles not to speak in Jesus' name, and Christ himself, when reviled, threatening not, but committing himself to the one who judges righteously. The same verb, two opposite uses.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Christ's silence under threat is the pattern for mine: I do not have to win the argument to be safe.
